Interface ClientHandler

All Superinterfaces:
VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
SocketClientHandler
public interface ClientHandler extends VirtualView
Server-side per-client connection handler.

Extends VirtualView with a lifecycle method for tearing down the underlying transport. Concrete implementations exist for each supported network technology: RmiClientHandler (RMI) and SocketClientHandler (Socket).

Both implementations guarantee that VirtualView notifications never block GameController while it holds its lock.
